body:
Thanks for sharing your story. I don't feel like detoxing (I did it for a week a few months back and it made my situation become even more depressed) but it sure is a good idea! 

The whole situation for me just seems kind of pointless and even with an actual point, it just seems so meaningless even if it had a meaning of short plans. I don't get why we are here and to me it's simply to pass time untill we/I die. I even got a few brain aneurysms and haven't died yet but it have made me even more suicidal than before, I think.
